title: Az-Zalzalah 99:4-6 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-'Adiyat, Az-Zalzalah and reading from the mushaf
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 54 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Az-Zalzalah 99:4-6 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 54. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا (٤) بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا (٥) يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ (٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it.
That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

questions.q: Chunk and link Az-Zalzalah 99:4-6 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 99:4-6 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Do one kind thing today in a place at home.
questions.a: For example: tidy the room for my family.

questions.q: On that Day the earth will ...
questions.a: A) tell its news. 99:4: 'That Day, it will report its news.'

questions.q: Think again: If the ground under your feet could talk, what would it say about what you did on it?
questions.a: On that Day the earth will tell its news (99:4): so we try to do good wherever we walk.
